form:FormGroup.label: Model
form:FormGroup.helpText: AI model used by Ask Stroom AI to answer questions. Only models you have Use permission on are listed.

form:FormGroup.label: Dock Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the Ask Stroom AI panel is shown: Dialog opens it in a pop-up window, Dock attaches it to the side of the main window.

form:FormGroup.label: Dock Location
form:FormGroup.helpText: Edge of the main window the Ask Stroom AI panel docks to: Right, Left, Top or Bottom. Only used when the dock type is Dock.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Only used when the dock type is Dock.

form:FormGroup.label: Chat System Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: Instructions sent to the AI model at the start of every chat, setting how the assistant should behave. A default prompt is provided. Currently only the value saved with Set As Default is used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Sent to the model at the start of every chat.

form:FormGroup.label: History Summary Prompt
form:FormGroup.helpText: Instructions used to summarise older messages when the conversation is too long for the model's context window. A default prompt is provided.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Used to summarise older messages when the chat is too long.

form:FormGroup.label: Maximum History Messages
form:FormGroup.helpText: Maximum number of earlier chat messages loaded as history for each question. Older messages are trimmed further if the model's context window is too small. Currently only the value saved with Set As Default is used. 1 to 500. Default is 200.
